subject: general
question: Buddhadev Dasgupta was a famous instrumentalist of which of the following instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarod**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Buddhadev Dasgupta** was a celebrated Indian classical musician known for his mastery over the **Sarod**.
 
• He was a prominent disciple of the **Shahjahanpur Gharana** of Sarod playing.
 
• Dasgupta was awarded the prestigious **Padma Bhushan** by the Government of India in recognition of his contribution to Indian classical music.
 
• He was also a recipient of the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**, which is one of the highest Indian recognitions given to practicing artists.
 
• His playing style is noted for its lyrical and expressive qualities, blending traditional elements with innovative techniques.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarod:**

 
 
• The Sarod is a stringed instrument used mainly in Indian classical music.
 
• It is known for its deep, weighty, introspective sound, unlike the sitar which has a lighter and more resonant tone.
 
• The Sarod is fretless, allowing the musician to slide between notes smoothly.
 
 
 
• **Shahjahanpur Gharana:**
 
 
• This Gharana is one of the principal schools of Sarod playing in India.
 
• It was founded by Ustad Murad Ali Khan in the 19th century.
 
• The style is characterized by its emphasis on both melody and rhythm.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan:**
 
 
• It is the third-highest civilian award in the Republic of India.
 
• Established on 2 January 1954, it is awarded for distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award:**
 
 
• This award is given by Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy for Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• It is the highest Indian recognition given to practicing artists.
